Dragon Ball Z - Ultime Menace.name: Dragon Ball Z: Super Butouden 3
Dragon Ball Z - Ultime Menace.summary: The third and final installment of the original Super Butouden trilogy brings the series to the Majin Buu Saga of the Dragon Ball Z story.

Jelly Boy.name: Jelly Boy
Jelly Boy.summary: Jelly Boy is a 1995 Europe-exclusive action platformer video game developed by Probe Entertainment and published by Ocean Software for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System and Nintendo Game Boy. The game was released exclusively in Europe in March 1995. Jelly Boy was planned to be released on the Sega Genesis but was canceled.
